name: Concept C (baseline): Tether network + STP Oberth
description: docs/analyses/reference-scenarios.md §4, concept-c-baseline. Starts inbound at 1 AU on a solar-plunge hyperbola with v_inf,in = 45.0 km/s and r_p = 3.5 R_sun (the speculative inbound tether network and JGA that produce it are not modelled). 24.0 km/s STP burn gives v_inf,SOM = 136.36 km/s; 15 speculative CNT tethers x 4.0 km/s (+60.0 km/s) at 10–30 AU, no hitchhike in the baseline. Doc reference: 196.36 km/s far-field linear (6.55e-4 c); 255.07 km/s if the tethers acted at perihelion.
